sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply the next word of the line 'the breath of ___'. Nothing on the earlier cards lets the baker work out 'life' rather than 'wisdom' or 'peace'. It is a guess at wording, not a reasoned pick.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply the next word of the line 'become one ___'. The story card before it never gives a hint toward 'flesh' rather than 'voice' or 'tribe'. It tests wording the baker hasn't seen.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.
